name: Ying Tse Lee
title: Software Engineer
description: Software engineer in Taipei building backend systems, data platforms and forecasting tools. Explore Rust services, Python libraries and interactive web projects.
descriptionZh: 台北的軟體工程師，做後端系統、資料平台與預測工具。這裡有 Rust 服務、Python 套件，以及可以直接試用的互動作品。

tagline.lead: I build systems that do the work, and **tools worth opening twice**.
tagline.sub: Backend engineering, data platforms and forecasting. From Japan’s electricity market to open-source tools you can try right here.

taglineZh.lead: 讓系統把事情做好，讓工具**值得再打開一次**。
taglineZh.sub: 專注後端、資料平台與預測。從日本電力交易系統，到可以直接試用的開源工具。

now: building power-trading systems for Japan's electricity market: market and weather data pipelines, bidding tools, spot-price forecasts.
nowZh: 替日本電力市場打造交易系統：市場與氣象資料管線、競價工具、現貨價格預測。
bio: I started in 2018 writing crawlers and NLP models, which is a polite way of saying I downloaded a lot of the internet and asked it how it felt. Then came a few years of computer vision and medical imaging: blur detection, face and pose models, brain MRI preprocessing. After that, a sentiment-analysis platform that read more than three billion posts so nobody else had to.
bioZh: 2018 年從爬蟲和 NLP 模型開始，說好聽是做資料，說白了就是把網路下載回家，再問它心情好不好。接著做了幾年電腦視覺與醫學影像：模糊偵測、人臉與姿態模型、腦部 MRI 前處理。之後做了一套情緒分析平台，替大家讀了超過三十億則貼文。
story: I started in 2018 writing crawlers and NLP models, which is a polite way of saying I downloaded a lot of the internet and asked it how it felt. Then came a few years of computer vision and medical imaging: blur detection, face and pose models, brain MRI preprocessing. After that, a sentiment-analysis platform that read more than three billion posts so nobody else had to.

Since 2023 I have worked on electricity: solar forecasting first, then trading strategy for the Japanese market. In practice that means data pipelines, bidding tools, price models, and a calendar that somehow filled up with meetings. JLPT N1 helps when the market publishes its rules in Japanese, and in 2026 I spent a few months in Tokyo finding out how much I still didn't know.

Python is home. Rust is where I go when something has to be fast and stay up, which is how Telepy's backend became a single Rust process. Most of my open-source tools exist because I needed them first and was too lazy to do the same job by hand twice.
storyZh: 2018 年從爬蟲和 NLP 模型開始，說好聽是做資料，說白了就是把網路下載回家，再問它心情好不好。接著做了幾年電腦視覺與醫學影像：模糊偵測、人臉與姿態模型、腦部 MRI 前處理。之後做了一套情緒分析平台，替大家讀了超過三十億則貼文。
2023 年開始做電力：先是太陽能發電預測，再來是日本市場的交易策略。實際上是資料管線、競價工具、價格模型，以及一個不知道為什麼被會議塞滿的行事曆。日文有 JLPT N1，在一個用日文公布規則的市場很好用；2026 年也在東京待了幾個月，認真體會自己還有多少不懂。
Python 是主場。需要又快又穩的時候就換 Rust，Telepy 的後端就是這樣變成一個 Rust 程序的。我的開源工具，大多是因為自己先需要，又懶得同一件事手動做兩次。
howIWork: Most of what I build now, I build together with AI coding agents. I decide what to make, how the pieces fit and whether it actually works. The agent writes a lot of the code, and I read every change before it ships.
howIWorkZh: 我現在做的東西，大多是和 AI coding agent 一起完成的。做什麼、怎麼拼、到底能不能用，由我決定；程式有很多是 agent 寫的，但每個改動上線前我都親自讀過。

eras.title: Crawlers & NLP
eras.note: First job. Scraped the web, trained language models, learned that regex is a lifestyle.
eras.noteZh: 第一份工作。爬網頁、訓練語言模型，學到正規表示式是一種生活方式。

eras.title: Computer vision
eras.note: Medical imaging, retail analytics and ads on embedded boards. Stared at a lot of pixels.
eras.noteZh: 醫學影像、零售分析、嵌入式廣告。盯著很多像素看。

eras.title: NLP & data platforms
eras.note: A sentiment platform over three billion data points. Most of them were complaints.
eras.noteZh: 處理超過三十億筆資料的情緒分析平台，大部分是抱怨。

eras.title: Energy trading
eras.note: Solar forecasts first, then power trading for Japan. The weather is now my problem.
eras.noteZh: 先做太陽能預測，再做日本電力交易。從此天氣變成我的問題。
